sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body: At its core, Space Rancher is a game about survival and progression. Players take on the role of a space cowboy, tasked with navigating through a procedurally generated galaxy, collecting resources, and battling against a variety of alien threats. The gameplay is fast-paced and action-packed, with a focus on quick reflexes and strategic decision-making. The controls are easy to learn, but difficult to master, making it a game that requires skill and dedication to progress.
